title: Factorization of the signed external Verdier contraction
statement:
Use the global finite-field and finite coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], so $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$. Work with the geometric derived operations on $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$, using the specified constructible exceptional adjunctions of [def-trf-admissibility]. All tensor products and pullbacks below are derived, with the signed symmetry of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $a_X:X\to s$ its structure map, $Z=X\times_sX$ with projections $p_1,p_2$, and $\tau:Z\to Z$ the factor exchange. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, $\omega=\omega_{X,A}$, $D=D_XK$, and $\operatorname{ev}:D\otimes K\to\omega$ be the dualizing data of [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. Set $P=Lp_1^*K\otimes Lp_2^*D$ and $Q=Lp_1^*D\otimes Lp_2^*K$. Write $s_P:R\tau_*P\xrightarrow{\sim}Q$ for the signed tensor swap. Identify $L\tau^*R\tau_*P=P$.

Define $\gamma:P\otimes Q\to\omega_{Z,A}$ by the permutation $(K_1,D_2,D_1,K_2)\mapsto(D_1,K_1,D_2,K_2)$ with its Koszul sign, followed by the two pullbacks of $\operatorname{ev}$ and the exceptional product map $\alpha_{a_X,a_X}:\omega\boxtimes\omega\to\omega_{Z,A}$ of [def-sf-kv-maps](ii). This is the contraction in [def-trf-supported-pairing], without a choice of supported classes. Let $\kappa:P\to R\mathcal Hom_A(Lp_2^*K,Rp_1^!K)$ be the map of [def-sf-kv-maps](iv), and $\kappa^T:P\otimes Lp_2^*K\to Rp_1^!K$ its tensor–Hom transpose. Let $\varpi:Lp_1^*D\otimes Rp_1^!K\to Rp_1^!\omega$ be the $Rp_{1!}\dashv Rp_1^!$ adjunct of
$$
Rp_{1!}(Lp_1^*D\otimes Rp_1^!K)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}^{-1}}D\otimes Rp_{1!}Rp_1^!K\xrightarrow{1\otimes\varepsilon_{p_1}}D\otimes K\xrightarrow{\operatorname{ev}}\omega.
$$
Use the composition identification $Rp_1^!\omega\cong\omega_{Z,A}$ of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition] and the factor-exchange identification $L\tau^*\omega_{Z,A}\cong\omega_{Z,A}$. With $r:L\tau^*P\otimes P\to Lp_1^*D\otimes(P\otimes Lp_2^*K)$ the signed permutation $(K_2,D_1,K_1,D_2)\mapsto(D_1,K_1,D_2,K_2)$, the following equality holds:
$$
L\tau^*\gamma\circ(1\otimes L\tau^*s_P)=\varpi\circ(1_{Lp_1^*D}\otimes\kappa^T)\circ r.
$$
All arrows use the specified geometric exceptional product, projection formula and adjunction maps; the equality includes their Koszul signs.
